name: Prompt Injection
blurb: Direct and indirect prompt injection: how instructions hidden in content hijack model behavior, documented attacks, and current defenses.

items.name: OWASP LLM01: Prompt Injection
items.note: The top-ranked risk in the OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications: user or third-party content that overrides the developer's instructions, in direct and indirect forms.

items.name: NIST AI 100-2: Adversarial Machine Learning taxonomy
items.note: NIST's formal taxonomy of attacks on AI systems, including direct and indirect prompt injection, with terminology the field increasingly standardizes on.

items.name: MITRE ATLAS knowledge base
items.note: MITRE's adversary tactics matrix for AI systems, modeled on ATT&CK, cataloguing prompt injection among real observed techniques with case studies.

items.name: Indirect injection in agent toolchains
items.note: Tool descriptions and retrieved content are instruction channels: the MCP specification's security best practices address injection through connected tools. This site tracks 1,800+ MCP servers.
